events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Marking three decades since the tragic shooting of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains undeniable. His voice resonated with so many, and his records still hit hard.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Commemorating the 56th anniversary of the passing of rock guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix's Genius
angles.copy: Few musicians have changed the game like Jimi Hendrix. On the anniversary of his passing, we're celebrating the enduring genius of a true rock icon.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... what's your go-to song from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' formidable frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock trailblazer, her influence is still felt far and wide.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. A true classic.

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the first-generation iPod 25 years ago, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed everything. Suddenly, '1,000 songs in your pocket' was a reality. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite Bond film or song? Licence to thrill since '62!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the indelible mark John Lennon left on music and the world. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many unforgettable comedic moments. What's your favourite?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. Its experimental sound and diverse tracks still spark debate and delight. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Power
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice, stage presence, and songwriting continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, 'Rubber Soul' showed a new side to The Beatles, paving the way for countless artists. A pivotal album in pop history!

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: Commemorating 46 years since the tragic assassination of music legend John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Always remembered.
